mapper.select: select policy_value from sys_policy where policy_key = #{policyKey} and plant_cd in (#{plantCd}, '*') order by case when plant_cd = '*' then 1 else 0 end limit 1
mapper.update: insert into sys_policy (comp_cd, plant_cd, policy_key, policy_value, created_by, updated_by) values (#{compCd}, #{plantCd}, #{policyKey}, #{value}, #{actor}, #{actor}) on conflict (comp_cd, plant_cd, policy_key) do update set policy_value = excluded.policy_value, row_ver = sys_policy.row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = excluded.updated_by
